articles.headline: New Warrior Yaxel Lendeborg 'used to hate Steph Curry' as Kyrie fan
articles.description: A decade after watching the evolution of the rivalry between the Warriors and Cavs, Michigan wing Yaxel Lendeborg was drafted by Golden State with the 11th pick Tuesday and admitted at the podium: "I'm a big Kyrie guy. So I used to hate Steph Curry."

images.name: Yaxel Lendeborg, Steph Curry [400x600] - Copy
images.caption: Yaxel Lendeborg met Stephen Curry when he attended the play-in game between the Warriors and Clippers in April. "He's a very great guy, genuine person," Lendeborg said Tuesday. "It's going to be an honor to be able to watch what he does in person."
